description: This is a Java unit test class for DefaultOAuthConfig, verifying immutability, equals/hashCode, and configuration value retrieval.

classes.name: DefaultOAuthConfigTest
classes.description: Unit test class for DefaultOAuthConfig, testing immutability, equality, and default/configured values.

methods.name: initTestFixture
